sources.title: Model Architecture | athena-team/athena | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Base Architecture All models in Athena inherit from a common BaseModel class, which provides a unified interface for various speech processing tasks. The base architecture establishes core functionality including loss calculation, metric computation, and standardized input/output handling.

sources.title: FLUX Gets an 'athena' LoRA on Modelers.cn - aichina.news
sources.snippet: If you build with FLUX, you already know that LoRAs are the fastest way to steer a base text-to-image model towards a particular subject or style without retraining. A new community LoRA called 'athena' has appeared on Modelers.cn, the Huawei/Ascend-focused AI platform that many Western developers have yet to explore.
